Even if you invest at the market peak now, 10 years from now, it will still be good returns (above traditional assets) without breaking your head over it. The only thing is to choose funds with low expenses. 

That's more than enough for most persons - not everybody has to be obsessed over pricking stocks and then tracking them individually. I've been doing it for over a decade (before the birth of the influencer community), no complaints whatsoever. Was never in losses even during 2021 (downturn yes).
